decisions.quote: Terman’s study was the first to systematically document the lives of the intellectually gifted. This cross-sectional study replicates and extends some of Terman’s findings on characteristics of the gifted in childhood
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files are absent for this request. Only the abstract is available in the supplied source text, and it states that the study replicates and extends some of Terman's findings on characteristics of the gifted in childhood without providing an in-text citation, publication year, title, or reference list entry. While shipped row input_row_index 138 (Terman, 1926, 'Genetic studies of genius') is a plausible match, the abstract alone does not settle whether the specific cited target publication is Terman (1926) or another volume/report of Terman's giftedness research.
